report.summary: In Australia, Bendigo and Adelaide Bank was fined $8 million over cybersecurity failures linked to a 2023 breach, ASX-listed Peninsula Energy halted trading after an incident hit systems at its US uranium mine, and a Darwin accountancy firm appeared on a ransomware leak site with claimed publication of Tax File Numbers and bank details. Two Australian AI reports landed, proposing 46 recommendations on safety, copyright and data centres with draft laws expected in early 2027.

items.title: Australian AI inquiry report: 46 recommendations on safety, copyright and data centres
items.why: Bendigo and Adelaide Bank's $8 million penalty over cybersecurity failures tied to a 2023 breach shows regulators are attaching real financial cost to breach-related failures in Australian banking.
